action.action-desc: Mr. Peters (for himself, Mr. Thompson of California, Mr. Levin, Ms. Waters, Mr. Cisneros, Ms. Jacobs, Mr. Costa, Mr. Huffman, Ms. Brownley, Ms. Friedman, Mr. Mullin, Mr. Aguilar, Mr. Vargas, Ms. Matsui, Mr. Ruiz, Ms. Kamlager-Dove, Mr. Bera, Mr. Panetta, Ms. Chu, Ms. Simon, Mr. Obernolte, Mr. Issa, Mr. Kiley of California, and Mr. Gray) introduced the following bill; which was referred to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform

form.official-title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4640 Cass Street in San Diego, California, as the Mary Wilding Memorial Post Office Building.

section.header: Mary Wilding Memorial Post Office Building

subsection.text: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 4640 Cass Street in San Diego, California, shall be known and designated as the Mary Wilding Memorial Post Office Building.

Any reference in a law, map, regulation, document, paper, or other record of the United States to the facility referred to in subsection (a) shall be deemed to be a reference to the Mary Wilding Memorial Post Office Building.
